message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of the sections and contents in an LLM context window.","description":"A tall, rounded rectangular outline represents the LLM Context Window, labelled vertically along its left side. Inside, three grey rounded header bars divide the contents into sections. Under “System Prompt” are bullets for “Agent definition and goals,” “Tool documentation,” “Sub-agent documentation,” and “System instructions.” Under “Core Prompt” are “Problem statement or instruction,” “Open files,” and “Directory tree.” Under “Assistant Messages” are “CoT reasoning,” “Tool calls and results,” “Sub-agent calls and results,” and “Overseer notifications.” The items are arranged as a vertical list; there are no arrows or other connections.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
